g1.flow: Wa-lā antum ʿābidūna mā aʿbud comes twice in identical words, so track the 'I' line before each. The surah alternates I, you, I, you. The first 'I' line is 'I do not worship what you worship'; the second is 'Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship'. Hook: the 'you' line never changes, only the 'I' line. After the second comes 'For you is your religion'.

cues.109:3: First 'you' line: follows 'I do not worship what you worship'.
cues.109:5: Second 'you' line: follows 'Nor will I be a worshipper'; next, 'For you is your religion'.
